permits.title: Main Street Car Barn – Install Signage (Jon Richards Company)
permits.description: Walt Disney Imagineering filed a Notice of Commencement to “install signage” at 4720C Caribbean Wy, the Main Street Car Barn (backstage vehicle storage for Main Street, U.S.A.). Contractor: Jon Richards Company FL, Inc. (frequent themed-elements collaborator). Standard one-year expiration. Filed by WDI rather than Facility Asset Management, suggesting visible/thematic signage work in a primarily backstage area that can be partially visible from guest areas.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – Main Street Car Barn (4720C Caribbean Wy)

permits.title: Disney’s BoardWalk Inn – General Construction (Abrahan Constructors)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed for “General Construction” at 2100 Epcot Resorts Blvd (BoardWalk Hotel Inn rooms 1201-5311; Villas rooms 1001-5095). Contractor: Abrahan Constructors, LLC. Standard one-year expiration. BoardWalk has multiple active projects including Hurly-Burly (former Jellyrolls), new restaurants/stores, and ongoing renovations; this filing may support one or more of those efforts or general maintenance.
permits.location: Disney’s BoardWalk – BoardWalk Inn / Villas (2100 Epcot Resorts Blvd)
